tagline.text: A northeast Cebu day of lighthouse heritage, lagoon scenery and rosquillos

location.label: Location
location.text: Poblacion, Catarman and the Silot Lagoon area, Liloan, Cebu

best_season.label: Best time to visit
best_season.text: Consider January–May for outdoor stops; check weather and access year-round

duration.label: Time needed
duration.text: One day, or an overnight visit with additional leisure activities

budget.label: Budget
budget.text: About ₱800–1,600 per person (illustrative local-day allocation; paid activities additional)

children.text: Liloan, north of Cebu City, combines Bagacay Point Lighthouse, San Fernando Rey Church, Silot Lagoon and ring-shaped rosquillos biscuits. Plan transport between the town center, lighthouse and lagoon for a day of heritage, food and coastal scenery.

Liloan is part of the expanding area northeast of Cebu City, with homes, shops, schools and waterfront facilities rather than an isolated beach-village setting. A church-area stop, the Catarman lighthouse and lagoon surroundings provide a different coastal view from Mactan’s resort districts. Divide midday travel with rest stops.

This entry covers northeastern Cebu’s Liloan, distinct from Liloan in Southern Leyte and the Liloan ferry port in Santander at Cebu’s southern end. Include Cebu and a specific landmark in directions. Poblacion, the coastal lighthouse and the small downtown lighthouse replica are separate stops.
The lighthouse is both a navigation structure and a town symbol. The NHCP record describes its
construction and

National Historical Landmark declaration. Distinguish older structures, today’s octagonal tower and the downtown replica. Heritage designation does not establish visitor access to the tower interior or lantern.
Rosquillos are crisp ring-shaped biscuits. Titay’s traces its Liloan baking tradition to Margarita Frasco in
. Distinguish factory location, retail shop and display outlet when planning a purchase. Local products are also sold elsewhere; a product photograph need not have been taken in the town.

Examine the Catarman tower and lantern from permitted ground-level positions. Arrange return transport rather than assuming a continuous walk from town. Use changing light and surrounding trees for photographs without climbing structures or boundaries.

The Poblacion church has a stone façade and twin towers. Read its dated features as different historical stages and respect its active worship role. Confirm interior and photography access and keep ceremonial routes clear.

Also called Silot Bay, the lagoon is linked to the sea and bordered by settlements and aquaculture or leisure facilities. Aerial photographs explain its shape, but do not establish public access or swimming along every shore. Use permitted paths and facility areas.

Operator MENCA lists activities including ziplining, kayaking and fishing. Choose one rather than forcing every attraction into a short heritage day. Confirm operation, booking, participant conditions and weather changes; archival images do not establish current equipment or prices.

Try the ring-shaped biscuit with its scalloped edge. At an actual retailer,check product,weight,date and packaging. Recipes differ among versions,so inspect allergens and current prices instead of assuming identical ingredients.

The lighthouse replica and Rizal monument add context to the church-area visit. Waterfront buildings such as Pier88 form part of local transport life. Seeing a terminal exterior does not establish a sailing route or schedule; verify an actual service before planning to board.

Liloan’s stops are not one enclosed park. This day plan separates the center from the lighthouse and lagoon. Check routes from your actual accommodation,especially from south Cebu City or Mactan. For extended paid activities,reduce the town walk or add another day.
Reach Poblacion,visit permitted church areas and take a short center walk,then buy water or snacks.
Visit the actual Catarman lighthouse by vehicle and allow a meal and rest,with return transport and drop-off arranged.
Choose an accessible lagoon-side area or one booked activity,buy biscuits and return,shortening outdoor stops in heavy rain.
Allow time for activities,meals,queues and equipment preparation at a confirmed operating venue,rather than compressing everything into the church visit day.

Cebu’s tourism guide describes buses,jeepneys and modern public transport along Cebu North Road through Mandaue and Consolacion. Confirm where a service stops and whether you need the church,lighthouse or lagoon. Indicative driving times vary with congestion and your starting point.
The air gateway is
CEB

on Mactan Island,requiring a road transfer through Metro Cebu. Specify Liloan,Cebu and the exact stop,and check return travel,waiting and additional stops. Consider luggage storage before a multi-stop outdoor visit.

Save separate pins for the downtown replica,Catarman lighthouse and each lagoon facility. A ride available at your starting point does not guarantee an immediate return from every stop. Agree timing,waiting point and contact details,and avoid an unfamiliar shoreline walk after dark.
Consider
January–May

for outdoor touring,while allowing for rain throughout the year. Put exposed lighthouse and coastal stops earlier or later in the day and rest indoors at midday. Worship,facility events and weekend traffic can change access.

children.text: The Rosquillos Festival is a separate cultural event rather than a performance included in a normal visit. Check the municipality’s program for the relevant year. Heritage designation or a tourism-development proposal does not guarantee a festival or nightly illumination.
An illustrative local-day allocation is

: meals300–500,water and snacks50–100,local transport250–600,and reserve200–400 pesos. These are allocations,not published tariffs. They sit at or slightly above the 2026 Cebu daily estimates of two travel guides (food about ₱200–900, local transport about ₱100–400). Flights,lodging,airport transfers,long-distance private vehicles and paid activities are additional. Add actual quotes after choosing transport and activities.
Amounts are personal planning examples as of
. Historical photograph descriptions do not establish today’s activity prices.

A day trip from Cebu City or Mactan depends on the accommodation’s location. For a Liloan stay,check final roads,evening meals and transport as well as proximity to water. A coastal location does not guarantee a swimmable beach or unrestricted shoreline access.

Rosquillos travel easily as gifts but need protective packaging. Use the retailer’s list to distinguish the Poblacion flagship from other outlets. At meal stops,check ingredients and preparation; a claim of locally caught seafood alone does not establish freshness or handling.

Craft and home-decoration products also illustrate local enterprise. The gallery’s craft image shows a2024 Metro Manila trade fair,not a Liloan shop. Confirm retail or ordering arrangements rather than assuming workshops or factories admit visitors.
Save Liloan,Cebu with the exact landmark to avoid Santander’s ferry port or the Southern Leyte municipality.
Distinguish the Catarman lighthouse from its downtown replica when planning stops.
Distinguish exterior viewing,interior entry and tower climbing,and follow access instructions.
Lagoon scenery does not establish water conditions or swimming access; use permitted areas and confirmed activities.
Plan shade,water and transport between exposed stops rather than walking every connection.
Check packaging,weight,allergens and shipping; archival displays and designs may have changed.
A northeastern Cebu visit differs from an inter-island journey at Santander’s Liloan port. Verify port,destination and actual service separately.
Do not climb lighthouse structures or shoreline edges without authorized visitor access.
Respect traffic and property boundaries and avoid standing in roads or crossing gates for photographs.
Check the operator’s current conditions for aerial or water activities rather than relying on archival images.
Allow a generous return before flights or important bookings; short distance does not remove Metro Cebu congestion.
Combine a separate day of heritage districts,markets and museums,leaving realistic transfer time.
Mactan provides an airport,resorts and marine activities,but access involves roads and bridges rather than a continuous beach route.
